intro: Work through your Autumn turn in order. The guide shows steps that apply to your Stone's current position.

children.label: Pass 1 — Rekindle & Harvest
children.body: Each player in turn order (clockwise from the Agekeeper).

children.label: Pay 5 Essence
children.body: From the Autumn of the Age after your Stone was Seized, pay 5 Essence, of any type, to return it to its previous Forge position. If that station is occupied, wait until it is free.

children.label: 2. Harvest Elemental Essence
children.body: Align your Harvest Sources (Zodiac Die, Astral Houses, Adept Cards, Spread Cards) with the Cosmic Age. Each matched Aspect pays 1 Essence; a Perfect Match scores +6.

children.label: Pass 2 — Fuel, Fire & Temper
children.body: After all players finish Pass 1, repeat turn order for Furnace fuel, Firing, and Tempering.

children.label: 1. Fuel Your Furnaces
children.condition: Craft Coal and place it in the Furnace matching your Sign's Element
children.body: Spend 3 cards of one suit to craft 1 Coal. Place your Coal in the Furnace matching your Sign's Element. Each Coal you own there raises your Heat by +1.

children.label: 2. Distill a Reagent (optional)
children.condition: Available on your turn — same rules as Summer
children.body: Spend 5 Essence of one Element to take 1 Reagent of that Element. Useful before you Fire or set Shield Reagents.

children.label: 3. Fire the Stone
children.condition: Stone on the Mantle Ring — complete an Alchemical Formula
children.body: Pay Attunement, Reagents, and Heat from an unfired Crucible Card. Move your Stone into the Forge. Commit up to 3 Reagents as Shield Reagents beside your Stone.

children.label: 4. Temper the Stone
children.condition: Stone has remained in the Forge for one full Age
children.body: Advance your Stone to the next Mantle Ring position. Set the completed Formula aside. Consume the Coal used, lowering your Heat.
